name: The King's Guild
description: Master artisans of the King's Guild each ply a different trade in a different quarter of the city. Work out who's who.
clues: Rowan, Tanner, and Countess belong to different artisans.
Aldric, Weaver, and Knight belong to different artisans.
Edmund does not go with Knight.
Earl goes with at least one of Cedric, Cooper, or Tanner.
Countess goes with neither Edmund nor Cooper.
Rowan goes with either Tanner or Bishop (but not both).
Knight goes with at least one of Edmund, Carpenter, or Tanner.
